```{r}
#| label: pkg_load_postgresql
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| eval: false
use("DBI", "dbConnect")
use("RPostgres", "Postgres")
use("tidywigits", "Wigits")
```

```{r}
#| label: postgresql_example
#| eval: false
in_dir <- system.file("extdata/oa", package = "tidywigits")
w <- Wigits$new(in_dir)
dbconn <- DBI::dbConnect(
  drv = RPostgres::Postgres(),
  dbname = "tidywigits",
  user = "user1"
)
res <- w$nemofy(
  format = "db",
  input_id = "run1",
  output_id = "out1",
  dbconn = dbconn
)
```
